readers.heading: No feed reader yet?
readers.intro: All of these are free to start, and all but Inoreader are open source. Pick the one that suits you, then paste the address above into it:
readers.netnewswire: if you use Apple devices. Simple and fast, for Mac, iPhone and iPad, kept in sync through iCloud. No AI.
readers.newsblur: if you want apps on all your devices. Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android, plus the web, kept in sync. Free for up to 64 sites, and around since 2010. AI tools only on its top plan.
readers.folo: if you want AI. Apps on everything, including Windows and Linux, kept in sync, free for up to 150 feeds, with AI summaries of your feeds and articles.
readers.fluentreader: if you want a desktop app for Windows, Mac or Linux. Clean and simple, with no AI. It can sync with Inoreader.
readers.feeder: if you read on an Android phone. Simple, with no AI.
readers.inoreader: if you want the most features: rules, filters, search, and AI tools on paid plans. On the web, iPhone and Android, kept in sync, free for up to 150 feeds (the free plan shows ads).
